page: Microsoft Azure D248ls_v7 is an instance in the Dlsv7 server family, operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 248 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel processor. The system is configured with 496.0 GB of RAM, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU.

This server does not include any local storage, meaning all storage operations rely on external Premium Storage volumes. It also lacks integrated GPUs and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. These specifications position the server as a dedicated compute resource where storage and networking are managed externally.

Designed as a low-memory, high-compute option, the D248ls_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that scale horizontally across many cores but do not require massive memory footprints. It is suited for parallel processing tasks, high-performance computing, batch processing, and distributed build systems.
